key_insight: CloakFEM generates valid, solvable FEM programs that expose resource-exhaustion vulnerabilities by sharply increasing solver work.
engineering_relevance: FEM simulation services may need computational safeguards because successful completion does not guarantee reasonable resource use.
method: Use a domain-guided LLM agent to search for adversarial FEM programs.
Represent candidates with an FEM-specific intermediate representation.
Apply a deterministic validity gate to enforce runnable constraints.
evidence_signal: Across three FEM stacks, 17 problem classes, and 1,068 seeds, CloakFEM outperformed five generic black-box baselines; the most extreme case increased solver iterations from 43 to 247,367 (5,752.72×).
watch_item: Iteration amplification is not necessarily proportional to wall-clock slowdown, and vulnerability can depend on the solver and problem.
paper_title: CloakFEM: Agentic FEM Code Generation for Red-Teaming Computational Resource Exhaustion
